RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel may reflect broader representation issues or breach institutional panel-composition policies. However, raising discrimination directly carries significant career risks. Lecturer appointments often hinge on interview performance, departmental fit, and specific curriculum needs—such as industry background—rather than publication metrics alone.

First, send a polite follow-up requesting your interview feedback. Simultaneously, check whether the university mandates gender-diverse hiring panels; a policy breach provides a legitimate procedural ground to raise with HR. Avoid alleging bias without documentation, as doing so can damage professional relationships in a tight academic field. Consider speaking confidentially with a faculty union representative or ombudsperson to evaluate your options.
